title: Focal Inferential Infusion Coupled with Tractable Density Discrimination for Implicit Hate Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of the FiADD framework for implicit hate speech detection using pretrained language models. While hate speech is a social and ethical topic, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems beyond standard classification metrics and a required 'Ethical Concerns' section.
